# dujiangyan-panda-base.com
> An independent travel guide to Dujiangyan Panda Base near Chengdu, China. Everything is on one page: closure status, volunteer program, ticket pricing, how to get there, best times to visit, Dujiangyan vs Chengdu comparison, nearby UNESCO attractions, and FAQ.

## Main Page
- [Complete Guide](https://www.dujiangyan-panda-base.com/): One page that answers every question about Dujiangyan Panda Base.
  - #closure — Current closure status (closed April 23, 2026 for renovation) and official announcement
  - #tickets — Entrance fees (adult CNY 58, student CNY 29, seniors/children free), where to buy
  - #volunteer — Panda keeper volunteer program: cost (CNY 700-900), daily schedule, age/health requirements, booking
  - #getting-there — How to reach the base from Chengdu: high-speed train, bus, taxi, organized tour with costs and times
  - #best-time — Best time to visit: seasonal and month-by-month guide (spring & autumn best)
  - #comparison — Dujiangyan vs Chengdu Panda Base side-by-side comparison
  - #nearby — Nearby UNESCO attractions: Dujiangyan Irrigation System, Mount Qingcheng
  - #alternatives — Where to see pandas while Dujiangyan is closed: Panda Valley, Wolong, Bifengxia, Chengdu Base
  - #visit-guide — Panda daily rhythm, best viewing times, packing checklist
  - #stories — First-hand volunteer experience and booking reality check
  - #faq — Frequently asked questions (13 answered)
